items.source: Create a LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean for the given persistence unit.
items.translation: 为给定的持久化单元创建LocalEntityManagerFactoryBean。

items.source: Note: PersistenceConfiguration includes a persistence unit name, so this effectively overrides the setPersistenceUnitName(String) method. In contrast, locally specified JPA properties (AbstractEntityManagerFactoryBean.setJpaProperties(Properties)) will get merged into the given PersistenceConfiguration instance.
items.translation: 注意：PersistenceConfiguration 包含持久化单元名称，因此这实际上覆盖了 setPersistenceUnitName(String) 方法。相比之下，本地指定的 JPA 属性（AbstractEntityManagerFactoryBean.setJpaProperties(Properties)）将与给定的 PersistenceConfiguration 实例合并。

items.source: Configuration settings are usually read from a META-INF/persistence.xml config file, residing in the class path, according to the JPA standalone bootstrap contract. See the Java Persistence API specification and your persistence provider documentation for setup details. Additionally, JPA properties can also be added on this FactoryBean via AbstractEntityManagerFactoryBean.setJpaProperties(Properties)/AbstractEntityManagerFactoryBean.setJpaPropertyMap(Map).
items.translation: 配置设置通常根据 JPA 独立引导合同，从类路径中的 `META-INF/persistence.xml` 配置文件读取。有关设置详细信息，请参阅 Java Persistence API 规范以及您的持久化提供程序文档。此外，还可以通过此 FactoryBean 上的 AbstractEntityManagerFactoryBean.setJpaProperties(Properties)/AbstractEntityManagerFactoryBean.setJpaPropertyMap(Map) 添加 JPA 属性。

items.source: Note: This FactoryBean has limited configuration power in terms of the configuration that it is able to pass to the JPA provider. If you need more flexible configuration options, consider using Spring's more powerful LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean instead.
items.translation: Note: 此 FactoryBean 在能够传递给 JPA 提供者的配置方面具有有限的配置能力。如果您需要更灵活的配置选项，请考虑使用 Spring 功能更强大的LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean。

items.source: When configured here, the JDBC DataSource will also get autodetected by JpaTransactionManager for exposing JPA transactions to JDBC accessors.
items.translation: 在此配置时，`JpaTransactionManager` 也会自动检测 JDBC DataSource，以便向 JDBC 访问器暴露 JPA 事务。

items.source: As of 7.0, This uses "default" for the default persistence unit name.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，此功能使用"default"作为默认持久化单元名称。
